categories.label: Gold and silver cards
categories.hint: Add the values of all gold and silver cards; score points equal to the total.

categories.label: Sets of 3 exactly matching cards
categories.hint: 100 VP per set of 3x20s or 3x30s of one currency, 3x gold, or 3x silver (counts even in a weak currency position).

endCondition.description: When the last deck card is dealt while refilling the market, play one more round, then final scoring.

notes: family: set-collection. Currencies are interchangeable in scoring; with fewer than 5 players some currencies are removed from the game, leave unused currency inputs at 0. Each currency has 3x20, 3x30, 1x40, 50, 60 (a full currency = 300 value + 200 in set bonuses). Gold and silver cards have their own printed values.
